scope: scripts/qualify_fio_tag_routes.py on a frozen Debug build of 4a0dea87 (artifacts/an2, git archive), 48/48 steps, in one owned scratch with the standard CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1 and an added CPU 1511F-1 PN 6ES7 511-1FL03-0AB0/V4.1 (configureScratchSecurity, failsafeRuntimeAccess; owned scratch only) plus an ET 200SP station with two F-DI 8x24VDC HF 6ES7 136-6BA01-0CA0/V2.0 on its IO system (the first F-DI's inputs start at byte 0). F-I/O tag addresses (1 November audit fix): change_prepare refused with SafetyBoundary, naming %I0.0 and the first F-DI's F-I/O, tag_create of a new tag at %I0.0 in the F-PLC's table FioTags, tag_set of FioProbe's LogicalAddress from %M40.0 to %I0.0, tag_table_import_xml of a new table with one tag at %I0.0, and vci_synchronize WorkspaceToProject of FioTags, mapped by export in SimaticML (the only VCI format V21 offered for the tag table) to a workspace outside the project and the artifact store, after its package file was edited from %M40.0 to %I0.0; library_instantiate of a master copy of the standard PLC's McTags into the F-PLC refused with SafetyBoundary naming the master copy and an F-DI. After each refusal every tag table and tag of both PLCs (software_inspect) was unchanged. The bit-memory routes applied with checkpoint, compile and save and read back: the FioTags package edited to %M41.0 synchronized project-ward, McTags with McProbe at %M60.0 imported into the standard PLC, and its master copy instantiated into the standard PLC after McProbe and McTags were deleted there.
limitations: One owned scratch: a standard CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1 and a CPU 1511F-1 PN with two ET 200SP F-DI 8x24VDC HF; addresses in the first F-DI's input range only. F-output ranges, ET 200MP and other F-modules are not exercised.
The project-ward vci_conflict_resolve route and block or SCL imports with absolute operands are not exercised; V21 offered only SimaticML as a tag table's VCI format.
The F-CPU's generated scratch user holds Full access including fail-safe (owned scratch only); no safety login, password or download.
